unit: published source row; no stable official facility ID

before.date: Archive capture 2024-10-18T21:17:32Z / Taipei 2024-10-19; survey date unknown

addressNormalization: Unicode NFKC; remove Unicode whitespace; replace 臺 with 台. Key includes district and full address. Preserve numbers, directions and punctuation. No fuzzy or spatial pairing.
coordinateNormalization: Finite Decimal values normalized numerically. Non-numeric tokens retain NFKC text with whitespace removed. Do not repair malformed values.
rules: Within each district/address group, pair equal normalized longitude and latitude fields as a multiset, in source row order: same_fields.
If the original address group has exactly one row on each side, pair differing coordinate fields: same_address_changed. This is a candidate for checking, not a confirmed move.
Shared addresses with multiple original rows keep all unpaired rows as ambiguous. Do not force residual pairs, even when only one side remains.
A district/address key absent entirely in 2026 is not_reappeared. The inverse is only_2026. These are source-coverage categories, not removal or installation events.
invariants: Every source row occurs exactly once in entries.
Before rows = same_fields pairs + same_address_changed pairs + ambiguous before rows + not_reappeared rows.
After rows = same_fields pairs + same_address_changed pairs + ambiguous after rows + only_2026 rows.
Apply conservation globally and in every district. Preserve raw fields and source line numbers.
limits: Neither snapshot has verified physical citywide completeness; current catalog count differs from the downloadable main file.
Addresses can be renamed or reformatted beyond these normalization rules; absence of a match is not evidence of removal.
Equal address and coordinate fields do not establish physical facility identity. Co-located rows remain distinct.
Archive capture is not an original survey or update date. Do not estimate removals or new installations from row deltas.
